entry.title: Public Access Cable Committee (PACC): agenda posted for the meeting of 9 November 2026
entry.summary: The town posted the agenda for the Public Access Cable Committee (PACC) meeting of 9 November 2026. The agenda itself: https://www.lunenburgma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_11092026-8107

entry.title: Public Access Cable Committee (PACC): the meeting of 19 October 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: PACC backed a salary-line warrant request for the November warrant; its longtime chair announced resignation. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j9toEn9gN2o), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.

entry.title: Public Access Cable Committee (PACC): the meeting of 16 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: PACC voted by roll call, 3 yes, to ask Town Meeting to fully fund its FY27 PEG access budget from retained earnings. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OiwZv1YBXj0), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
